name: Names from an upgrade ('upgrade a sandbox holding v1 data to 1.1 → names appear') after the first start of 1.1 on a bookmark file written by Bookmarks 1.0.0: as admin, every bookmark the upgrade named (a 1.0 note of at most 100 characters on one line) shows that name as its title on My Bookmarks (flat view) and in a video's 'My bookmarks (n)' section, and a longer or multi-line note stays the note (its first line the title). The expectations come from the API's own list, so the check holds for any upgraded file.

steps.name: admin's bookmarks as the API lists them
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { limit: 200 }))).Items.map(b => ({ id: b.Id, item: b.ItemId, name: b.Name || null, note: b.Note || null }))

steps.name: the upgrade named some and kept notes
a named bookmark's title is its name; an unnamed one with a note shows the note's first line
steps.assert: __vars.api.every(b => { const r = __vars.rows.find(x => x.id === b.id); if (!r) return false; if (b.name) return r.title === b.name; if (b.note) return r.title === b.note.split(/\r?\n/)[0].slice(0, 80) || b.note.split(/\r?\n/)[0].startsWith(r.title.replace(/…$/, '')); return /^(Bookmark at|Range) /.test(r.title); })

steps.name: a video with a named bookmark
'My bookmarks (n)' with the rows' titles
steps.waitFor: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('#itemDetailPage:not(.hide) .jfbm-section'); if (!s || s.classList.contains('hide')) return false; const rows = Array.from(s.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row')); return rows.length > 0 ? rows.map(r => ({ id: r.getAttribute('data-id'), title: r.querySelector('.jfbm-row-title').textContent })) : false; })()

steps.name: the named ones under their names there too
steps.assert: __vars.api.filter(b => b.item === __vars.itemId && b.name).every(b => __vars.section.some(r => r.id === b.id && r.title === b.name))

steps.name: no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag excepted)
